Requirements: The Minor in Management is available to any non-Business major. Freshman students are not eligible to declare the minor. Students must have a minimum 2.5 GPA in order to declare the minor. Students must complete the following courses with a grade of 'C' or better: MGMT 300 - Principles of Management and Operations (3 units). To complete the minor, students must complete an additional 12 units of 300 or 400-level management (MGMT) or human resources management (HRM) courses.
Program name: Minor in Management

Requirements: Admission to the Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a concentration in Marketing is subject to university impaction requirements. Freshmen applicants are evaluated based on their high school GPA. Transfer applicants must complete specific major-specific prerequisite courses with a minimum grade of C or better, including: Calculus for Business (or Calculus I), Principles of Financial Accounting, Principles of Managerial Accounting, Computer Information Systems, Principles of Macroeconomics, and Principles of Microeconomics. All applicants must meet the minimum cumulative GPA set for the College of Business.
